properties.description: Future work explicitly outside the one-human/one-agent MVP. Extend Broccoli sessions/channels to multiple human and agent participants. Each agent can have model/effort, role/system instructions and context-sensitive activation: ping-only, every-message, or a programmable predicate using deterministic logic, a model call, or both. Define participant-specific execution/stop behavior and how incoming messages influence busy agents; no universal interrupt policy is assumed. Reuse and extend Pi capabilities before replacing agent-loop behavior. Trace to Input Shared channels and participant-owned agent controls. Do not block current MVP acceptance on this future scope.
properties.title: Support shared conversations and programmable agent participation
